I am grateful for all my friends. Here are is what some of my females friends taught me that I'm grateful for. They helped how to speak up for myself, helped me build some confidence, they showed me that when we have bad times, and only want to speak to certain people, the people we don't feel like speaking to shouldn't feel like they don't like them, we do still like them, we're just limited right now. Here is what a great male friend I had brought to me. He brought peace to me, he helped me, respected me, his poems brought comfort when I was down, and for that I'm grateful. I'm also most grateful for my family. My mom, she taught me how a healthy relationship should be, she taught me how a women should be. She HELPED me, she helped me love myself, help me understand so much things, and she did so much more of course. My dad, he works for money so that way we can have food on out plate and a roof over out head, he taught me how a man should treat me in a relationship. My brother and sister, man they taught me so much, they're annoying yes but I still love them, because I know that even when they bother me, tease me, they still love me and will be there for me. I'm grateful for many other people. But these are the main ones. Good bye ❤️
